'''Scott DiBenedetto''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Rochester tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with Home One War Room start, according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1686">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ rochester-ny-1-27], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 29 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
